detailed_description: Line Counter shows live line statistics for whatever text is in the textarea: total lines, non-empty lines, empty lines, and unique lines (counted from trimmed non-empty lines). Three buttons act on the textarea in place: Remove Duplicates keeps the first occurrence of each trimmed line (and also drops empty lines when the Ignore Empty checkbox is on), Remove Empty drops every blank/whitespace-only line, and Sort Lines sorts in place using locale compare. There is no separate Count button - stats update reactively as you type. The tool does not save files, undo a transformation, group/regroup by patterns, or report file size or character counts.
usage_steps: Paste or type lines into the textarea
Watch the four stat cards update: total, non-empty, empty, and unique lines
Optionally tick Ignore Empty to also drop blank lines while removing duplicates
Click Remove Duplicates to keep only the first occurrence of each trimmed line
Click Remove Empty to drop every blank or whitespace-only line
Click Sort Lines to sort the textarea in place using locale compare
usage_examples: Paste a list of email addresses and click Remove Duplicates to keep only unique entries
Drop blank lines from a copied log snippet with Remove Empty before pasting it elsewhere
Sort a list of file names alphabetically before saving it to a script
Check the unique line count to see how many distinct entries a list actually has
